34000.notes: agent noun used verbally see Perniola §292

examples.text: abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, aggivessana, anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ desetā. apissu maṃ ekam'eko evaṃ maññati, mam'ev'ārabbha samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī'ti.

34001.synonym: anusāsati, jānāpeti, pakāseti, paññapeti, paññāpeti, pavedayati, pasāsati, vāceti, sandasseti, sikkhāpayati, sikkhāpeti

examples.text: bhārañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi bhārahārañ'ca bhār'ādānañ'ca bhāranikkhepanañ'ca. taṃ suṇātha. katamo ca, bhikkhave, bhāro?
ussādanañ'ca jaññā, apasādanañ'ca jaññā, ussādanañ'ca ñatvā apasādanañ'ca ñatvā n'ev'ussādeyya, na apasādeyya, dhammam'eva deseyya.

34002.grammar: pr, caus of disati, trans (+acc & +dat or +loc)

examples.text: yadāyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ yā c'eva āyasmantānaṃ āpatti, yā ca attano āpatti, āyasmantānañc'eva atthāya, attano ca atthāya, saṅghamajjhe tiṇ'avatthārakena deseyyaṃ, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.

34003.meaning1: wishing to teach; wanting to preach

34005.meaning1: to preach; to teach; to explain (to)

examples.text: sakkā evam'evaṃ viññāṇam'p'idaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ iti'p'idaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattā'ti.
na kho, ānanda, sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ. paresaṃ, ānanda, dhammaṃ desentena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo. katame pañca?

34006.meaning1: having preached; having taught; having explained (to)
34006.meaning2: having pointed out, having preached, having expounded

examples.text: te sāvake upanetvā pabbajite, sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā pabbajitānaṃ, sāvakesu gedhitacittā pabbajitesu, kāyassa bhedā pāṇ'upacchedā hīne kāye patiṭṭhitā.
evarūpaṃ te, rāhula, kāyakammaṃ satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu desetabbaṃ, vivaritabbaṃ, uttānīkātabbaṃ, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjitabbaṃ.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
n'ābhāsamānaṃ jānanti, missaṃ bālehi paṇḍitaṃ, bhāsamānañ'ca jānanti, desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ.

so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhāna-adhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhāna-abhinivesa-anusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.
accayaṃ accayato na passati, accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ nappaṭikaroti, parassa kho pana accayaṃ desentassa yathādhammaṃ nappaṭiggaṇhāti

34010.meaning1: could preach; could teach; could explain (to)

examples.text: saṃkhittena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, vitthārena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, saṃkhittavitthārena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, aññātāro ca dullabhā'ti.

yadāyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ yā c'eva āyasmantānaṃ āpatti, yā ca attano āpatti, āyasmantānañc'eva atthāya, attano ca atthāya, saṅghamajjhe tiṇ'avatthārakena deseyyaṃ, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.

34012.synonym: adesayi, adesesi, desayi, nidaṃsesi, pakāsesi, pavedesi

examples.text: sace kho tvaṃ, mārisa, evaṃ pajānāsi, sace tvaṃ evaṃ anubuddho, mā sāvake upanesi, mā pabbajite, mā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, mā pabbajitānaṃ, mā sāvakesu gedhim'akāsi, mā pabbajitesu.
aññassa bhagavā buddho, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā, dhamme desiyamānamhi, sotam'odhesim'atthiko, taṃ me amoghaṃ savanaṃ, vimutto'mhi anāsavo.

34013.meaning1: will point out; will preach; will expound
34013.commentary: (VINa) dhammaṃ vā desessāmā'ti aṭṭh'uppattiyuttaṃ suttaṃ vā pubbacaritakāraṇayuttaṃ jātakaṃ vā kathayissāma.

examples.text: na pāduk'āruḷhassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na taṃ yāce yassa piyaṃ jigiṃse, desso hoti atiyācanāya, nāgo maṇiṃ yācito brāhmaṇena, adassanaṃ'y'eva tadajjhagamā'ti.
na me dessā ubho puttā, maddī devī na dessiyā.

34017.meaning1: hating; enemy of; who is against

examples.text: suvijāno bhavaṃ hoti, suvijāno parābhavo, dhammakāmo bhavaṃ hoti, dhammadessī parābhavo.
saccaṃ bhaṇe na kujjheyya, dajjā appam'pi yācito, etehi tīhi ṭhānehi, gacche devāna santike.
yo so yodh'ājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tam'enaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī'ti.
devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati, amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati. sādhu mayam'pi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma, puññāni kareyyāmā'ti.

sādhu, devo, vāhanāgāresu ca dvāresu ca āṇāpetu, yena vāhanena jīvako icchati tena vāhanena gacchatu, yena dvārena icchati tena dvārena gacchatu, yaṃ kālaṃ icchati taṃ kālaṃ gacchatu, yaṃ kālaṃ icchati taṃ kālaṃ pavisatū'ti.

34020.meaningLit: god; i.e. Indra, god of the heavens

examples.text: devo ca vassati devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati, ekako c'āhaṃ bherave bile viharāmi, tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato, n'atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā.
pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

34021.meaningLit: god; i.e. Indra, god of the heavens

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
seyyathā'pi nāma saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ osadhitārakā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

34022.meaning1: divine maiden; celestial nymph; heavenly girl

examples.text: tattha cittaṃ paṇidhehi, yattha te vusitaṃ pure, tāvatiṃsesu devesu, sabbakāmasamiddhisu, purakkhato parivuto, devakaññāhi sobhasī'ti.
pabhā niddhāvate tassa, sataraṃsī'va uggato, ākiṇṇo devakaññāhi, āmodiṃ kāmakām'ahaṃ.

atha kho āyasmā ānando sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi, āyām'āvuso, yena devakatasobbho ten'upasaṅkamissāma guhādassanāyā'ti. evam'āvuso'ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.

34024.meaning1: host of heavenly beings; group of gods

examples.text: mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ, devakāyā samāgatā, āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ, dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti.
ye keci buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatāse, na te gamissanti apāyabhūmiṃ, pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ, devakāyaṃ paripūressantī'ti.

34025.grammar: masc loc sg of devakāya, comp, irreg form of devakāyasmiṃ
34025.meaning1: in the host of heavenly beings; among the group of gods
34025.construction:
deva + kāya + smiṃ > smi
devakāya + smi
34025.commentary: (SNa) n'atthi dāni pun'āvāso, devakāyasmi jālinī'ti… devate devakāyasmiṃ devasamūhe upapajjanavasena puna āvāso āvasanaṃ idāni mayhaṃ n'atthī'ti attho.

examples.text: n'atthi dāni pun'āvāso, devakāyasmi jālini, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti.

34028.meaning1: group of gods; class of deities

examples.text: tesaṃ nisinnānaṃ abhikkamiṃsu, vīrā virāgā virajaṃ karontā, te disvā saṃvegam'akāsi vāsavo, dev'ābhibhū devagaṇassa majjhe.
gandhabbakāyaṃ paripūrentī'ti gandhabbadevagaṇaṃ paripūrenti.

34029.meaning1: who criticizes the gods; who finds fault with the gods

examples.text: ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtagarahakā bhūtajigucchakā, devagarahakā devajigucchakā, pajāpatigarahakā pajāpatijigucchakā, brahmagarahakā brahmajigucchakā
atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto anattamano ahosi, kathañ'hi nāma devo devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpad'atthāya nikkhittāni dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dassatī'ti!

34032.meaning1: travelling amongst the gods; journey in heaven

examples.text: bhavanā nikkhamitvāna, caranto devacārikaṃ, yadā icchāmi gamanaṃ, devasaṅghapurakkhato.
yadā buddho atthadassī, carate devacārikaṃ, koṭisatasahassānaṃ, dutiy'ābhisamayo ahu.

34033.meaningLit: discourse on gods passing away onto hell, etc.
34033.sanskrit: deva + cyuti + niraya + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

34035.meaning1: who is repulsed by the gods; who is disgusted with the gods
34035.meaning2: who dislikes or disapproves of the gods

examples.text: ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtagarahakā bhūtajigucchakā, devagarahakā devajigucchakā, pajāpatigarahakā pajāpatijigucchakā, brahmagarahakā brahmajigucchakā

34036.meaning1: one of the gods; member of the deities

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhu, amanussaggāho? idha, bhikkhu, ekacco aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti.

yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
manussānaṃ piyo hoti, amanussānaṃ piyo hoti, devatā rakkhanti, n'āssa aggi vā visaṃ vā satthaṃ vā kamati, tuvaṭaṃ cittaṃ samādhiyati, mukhavaṇṇo vippasīdati
anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

34039.meaning1: obligation to the gods; responsibility to the deities
34039.commentary: (MNt) gandha-puppha-vilepana-jālā-bhattehi kālena kālaṃ devatānaṃ pūjā devatākaraṇīyaṃ, devatābalī'ti attho

examples.text: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?

34040.meaning1: cared for by gods; treated with compassion by deities

examples.text: tato naṃ anukampan'ti, mātā puttaṃ'va orasaṃ, devat'ānukampito poso, sadā bhadrāni passatī'ti.

34041.meaning1: recollection of (the qualities of) divine beings

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno devat'ānussatiṃ bhāveti

34043.commentary: (ANa) devatābalin'ti devatānaṃ kattabbabaliṃ. sabbam'etaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ yath'ānucchavikavasena dātabbadānassa adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sed'āvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi pañcabaliṃ kattā hoti, ñātibaliṃ, atithibaliṃ, pubbapetabaliṃ, rājabaliṃ, devatābaliṃ. idam'assa tatiyaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.

34044.meaning1: spoken by a deity; preached by a gods

examples.text: dhammo nāma buddhabhāsito, sāvakabhāsito, isibhāsito, devatābhāsito, atth'ūpasañhito, dhamm'ūpasañhito.

ettāvatā ca iminā vipassissa bhagavato apadānānusārena vitthārakathanena, tathāgatassevesā, bhikkhave, dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā'ti evaṃ vuttāya dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhabhāvaṃ pakāsetvā idāni, devatā'pi tathāgatassa etam'atthaṃ ārocesun'ti vuttaṃ devat'ārocanaṃ pakāsetuṃ ekam'id'āhan'ti-ādim'āha.
tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, devanikāye anekāni devatāsatāni anekāni devatāsahassāni yen'āhaṃ ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, devanikāye anekāni devatāsahassāni anekāni devatāsatasahassāni yen'āhaṃ ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
eten'upāyena yāva brahmalokā saddo abbhuggacchi. tena saddena mahā devatāsannipāto ahosi. thero mahantaṃ devatāsannipātaṃ disvā samacittasutt'antaṃ kathesi.

34049.meaning1: one thousand deities; a thousand gods
34049.commentary: (MNa) anekānaṃ devatāsahassānan'ti āyasmatā rāhulena padum'uttarassa bhagavato pādamūle pālitanāgarājakāle patthanaṃ paṭṭhapentena saddhiṃ patthanaṃ paṭṭhapitadevatā'y'eva. tāsu pana kāci bhūmaṭṭhakā devatā, kāci antalikkhakā, kāci cātumahārājikā, kāci devaloke, kāci brahmaloke nibbattā. imasmiṃ pana divase sabbā ekaṭṭhāne andhavanasmiṃ'y'eva sannipatitā.

examples.text: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ anekāni devatāsahassāni pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gatāni

34056.meaning2: act of purification in the presence of the gods
34056.commentary: (ANa) devat'uposathan'ti devatā sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetvā attano guṇe anussarantena upavuttha-uposatho devat'uposatho nāma.

examples.text: tassa attano ca tāsañ'ca devatānaṃ saddhañ'ca sīlañ'ca sutañ'ca cāgañ'ca paññañ'ca anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti. ayaṃ vuccati, visākhe, ariyasāvako devat'uposathaṃ upavasati, devatāhi saddhiṃ saṃvasati, devatā ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
kodhaṃ jhatvā sukhaṃ seti, kodhaṃ jhatvā na socati, kodhassa visamūlassa, madhur'aggassa devate, vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti, tañ'hi jhatvā na socatī'ti.
atthakāmo'si me yakkha, hitakāmo'si devate, karomi tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ, tvaṃ'si ācariyo mama.

34058.meaning1: divinity; fact of being a deity

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ… bhūtānaṃ bhūtattena ananubhūtaṃ, devānaṃ devattena ananubhūtaṃ, pajāpatissa pajāpatittena ananubhūtaṃ, brahmānaṃ brahmattena ananubhūtaṃ

34059.meaning1: state of being a deity; godly state

examples.text: tvaññ'eva no citta karosi brāhmaṇo, tvaṃ khattiyo rājadasī karosi, vessā ca suddā ca bhavāma ekadā, devattanaṃ vā'pi tav'eva vāhasā.

34061.meaning1: generic monk's name used in examples; Deva the elder

examples.text: mettāsinehasiniddhāni pana nayanāni ummīletvā suppasannena mukhena olokanaṃ sammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma. devatthero, tissatthero arogo hotu app'ābādho'ti samannāharaṇaṃ parammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma.

34062.meaning1: name of a monk; relative and nemesis of the Buddha

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante devadatte. tatra kho bhagavā devadattaṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi

34067.meaning2: devadattiya adj given by a deity

34068.meaningLit: lake of the gods; (or) fire of the gods
34068.commentary: (MNa) devadahaṃ nāmā'ti devā vuccanti rājāno, tattha ca sakyarājūnaṃ maṅgalapokkharaṇī ahosi pāsādikā ārakkhasampannā, sā devānaṃ dahattā devadahan'ti paññāyittha. tadupādāya so'pi nigamo devadahan'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gato. bhagavā taṃ nigamaṃ nissāya lumbinivane viharati. (SNa) devadahan'ti devā vuccanti rājāno, tesaṃ maṅgaladaho, sayaṃjāto vā so daho'ti, tasmā devadaho'ti vutto. tassa avidūre nigamo devadahan'tv'eva napuṃsakaliṅgavasena saṅkhaṃ gato.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati devadahaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.

34073.meaning2: Chapter 14 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… ukkāpāto bhavissati, disāḍāho bhavissati, bhūmicālo bhavissati, devadudrabhi bhavissati, candimasūriyanakkhattānaṃ uggamanaṃ ogamanaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vodānaṃ bhavissati
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… candaggāhaṃ sūriyaggāhaṃ sukkarāhucaritaṃ uḷuggahayuddhaṃ devadundubhissaraṃ okkanti ukkāpātaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

34077.meaningLit: sound of the drums of the gods

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… candaggāhaṃ sūriyaggāhaṃ sukkarāhucaritaṃ uḷuggahayuddhaṃ devadundubhissaraṃ okkanti ukkāpātaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

34078.meaning1: messenger of the gods; divine envoy

examples.text: ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtan'ti? so evam'āha n'āddasaṃ bhante'ti
uttam'aṅgaruhā mayhaṃ, ime jātā vayoharā, pātubhūtā devadūtā, pabbajjāsamayo mamā'ti.

34079.meaning1: messenger of the gods; divine envoy
34079.commentary: (ANa) devadūtānī'ti devadūtā. ayaṃ pan'ettha vacan'attho, devo'ti maccu, tassa dūtā'ti devadūtā. (ANt) devadūtānī'ti liṅgavipallāsaṃ katvā vuttan'ti āha devadūtā'ti, ubhayaliṅgaṃ vā etaṃ padaṃ, tasmā napuṃsakaliṅgavasena pāḷiyaṃ vuttassa pulliṅgavasena atthadassanaṃ kataṃ.

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, devadūtāni. katamāni tīṇi?

34082.meaningLit: section on messengers of the gods

34083.meaning1: god of gods; lord of lords; king of kings

examples.text: migaluddo pure āsiṃ, araññe kānane ahaṃ, disvāna taṃ devadevaṃ, tiṇamuṭṭhiṃ adās'ahaṃ.

34086.meaning2: member of a particular sect (of ascetics ?)

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato nigaṇṭho … muṇḍasāvako… jaṭilako… paribbājako… māgaṇḍiko… tedaṇḍiko… āruddhako… gotamako… devadhammiko yath'ābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. katamehi pañcahi?

34088.meaning1: city of the gods; divine citadel
34088.commentary: (BVa) devanagaraṃ vā'ti devanagaraṃ viya ālakamandā viya amaravatī samiddhanti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: atha te, jarasakko amhe matte katvā mahāsamuddapiṭṭhe khipitvā amhākaṃ devanagaraṃ gaṇhi, te mayaṃ tena saddhiṃ yujjhitvā amhākaṃ devanagaram'eva gaṇhissāmā'ti kipillikā viya thambhaṃ sineruṃ anusañcaramānā uṭṭhahiṃsu.
nagaraṃ sabb'aṅgasampannaṃ, sabbakammam'upāgataṃ, sattaratanasampannaṃ, nānājanasamākulaṃ, samiddhaṃ devanagaraṃ'va, āvāsaṃ puññakamminaṃ.

34089.meaning1: order of deities; class of devas

examples.text: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati. tassa tattha sukhino dhammapadā plavanti. dandho, bhikkhave, sat'uppādo, atha so satto khippaṃ'y'eva visesagāmī hoti.

katamo ca, bhikkhu, amanussaggāho? idha, bhikkhu, ekacco aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti.

34090.meaning1: answering questions by means of deities
34090.meaning2: asking questions by means of deities

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… jivhānibandhanaṃ hanusaṃhananaṃ hatth'ābhijappanaṃ hanujappanaṃ kaṇṇajappanaṃ ādāsapañhaṃ kumārikapañhaṃ devapañhaṃ ādicc'upaṭṭhānaṃ mahat'upaṭṭhānaṃ abbhujjalanaṃ siri'vhāyanaṃ

34091.meaning1: divine footprint; footstep of the gods; (comm) knowledge of the Buddha
34091.commentary: (SNa) devapadānī'ti devānaṃ ñāṇena, devassa vā ñāṇena akkantapadāni. (SNt) devapadānī'ti tesaṃ padāni devapadāni, devo'ti vā sammāsambuddho.

examples.text: cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.

34092.meaning1: possessing the quality of a divine footprint

examples.text: na ca kho pan'āhaṃ kiñci byābādhemi tasaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā. addhāhaṃ devapadadhammasamannāgato viharāmī'ti. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.

34093.meaning1: host of devas; assembly of deities

examples.text: tassa tattha na h'eva kho sukhino dhammapadā plavanti, api ca kho bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. tassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ vā so dhammavinayo, yatth'āhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarin'ti.

34094.meaning1: with a retinue of deities; surrounded by gods

examples.text: katame cattāro? asuro asuraparivāro, asuro devaparivāro, devo asuraparivāro, devo devaparivāro.

34095.meaning1: who praises the gods; who approves of the deities

examples.text: ye pana, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtapasaṃsakā bhūt'ābhinandino, devapasaṃsakā dev'ābhinandino, pajāpatipasaṃsakā pajāpat'ābhinandino, brahmapasaṃsakā brahm'ābhinandino, te kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā paṇīte kāye patiṭṭhitā.

34096.commentary: (SNa) devaputto'ti devānañ'hi aṅke nibbattā purisā devaputtā nāma, itthiyo devadhītaro nāma honti. (SNt) devassa putto devaputto.

examples.text: idhā'pi maṃ evaṃ jānanti gopako devaputto gopako devaputto'ti.
atha kho rohitasso devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

34097.meaning1: retinue of young deities; circle of minor gods

examples.text: atha kho susimo devaputto āyasmato sāriputtassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne mahatiyā devaputtaparisāya parivuto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

34098.meaning1: Māra in the sense of deity
